'''Lightning gloves''' were a rare type of [[Glove/Legends|glove]] in use during the [[Dark Wars]], a series of conflicts fought between the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The gloves produced strong electrical pulses when they came in contact with another object, a property which provided the user an advantage in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]].

==Description==
Lightning [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] generated powerful pulses of electricity when they made contact with an object, which was an advantage to the wearer during [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. In addition, they provided the user with considerable protection against electricity. The gloves' outsides were a [[Color/Legends|light blue]] color, and their insides were dark brown.<ref name="kotor2" />

==History==
Although lightning gloves were quite rare, they were in use<ref name="kotor2" /> during a series of conflicts known as the [[Dark Wars]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> which were fought between the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="kotor2" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> a pair of lightning gloves sold for around 29,600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lightning gloves first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] by [[Obsidian Entertainment]],<ref name="kotor2" /> which was released for Xbox on [[December 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="kotor2xbox">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2004/12/03/star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic-ii-the-sith-lords|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|author=Goldstein, Hilary|date=2004-12-03|work=IGN.com|archivedate=20130902052640}}</ref> and for PC on [[February 8]], [[2005]].<ref name="kotor2pc">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2005/02/08/star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic-ii-the-sith-lords-2|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|author=Butts, Steve|date=2005-02-08|work=IGN.com|archivedate=20140302112824}}</ref> In ''The Sith Lords'', the gloves were rare and could be found at randomly determined locations throughout the game; thus they were not guaranteed to be found every time through the game. The weapons granted a very large electrical damage bonus and a small attack bonus to unarmed attacks, as well as a large reduction in damage taken from electricity.<ref name="kotor2" />
